summary: Committed the Gizmo-shell-preservation fix for Pi web mode, then began implementing a minimal 'default Pi mode' in the agent server that uses `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent`'s default resource discovery. Added `defaultPiAgentDir`/`defaultPiRuntimePaths` to `pi-runtime-config.ts`, switched `pi-agent-service.ts` to use them when `GIZMO_PI_WEB=1`, and wired a project-trust resolver that defers to Pi's `ProjectTrustStore` and `defaultProjectTrust` setting (per user decision).
decisions: Committed prior shell-preservation work as 'fix: preserve Gizmo shell in Pi web mode' before proceeding.
When `GIZMO_PI_WEB=1`, the agent server uses default Pi runtime paths (`~/.pi/agent`) and skips `importPiRuntimeConfig`, letting Pi's default resource discovery take over.

Project trust in Pi Web mode follows Pi settings: trust resources that don't require trust, return `ProjectTrustStore.get(cwd)` if saved, otherwise fall back to `settingsManager.getDefaultProjectTrust() === 'always'` (user-chosen 'Follow Pi settings' option).
errors: rg command failed with exit code 2 because `apps/agent-server/README.md` does not exist; the targeted grep otherwise succeeded against the listed files.
